rows.scope: Flat report: label "External (name)", IPM pinned first in every sort, name/name-desc by lowercase label, version by numeric triple then prerelease text ("~" for release) then case-sensitive label; developer-mode marker. Native l0-l2, l5. ASCII labels; date sort, search, -description and -showupstream not modelled.

Tree: roots are installed modules no installed module depends on, in lowercase name order; each dependency printed under each parent (shared child twice); uninstalled dependency printed "[missing]" with no children; -s ignored. Native t0-t2. At most one dependency per module, so sibling order is not modelled.
